data.narrative:
Aventra is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by former Army Cyber and West Point personnel, having raised $3M to date. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer universe of 10 comparable companies across the defense-tech sector: 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis applied a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $3M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $8M. Peer-Median analysis examined four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). This peer set yielded a median valuation of $700M with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B, reflecting substantial heterogeneity within early-stage defense-tech valuations.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $354M. The wide dispersion between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty inherent in Seed-stage valuation: Stage-Progression anchors to capital raised and typical progression multiples, while Peer-Median captures market-proven comparable values but exhibits extreme variance. Key uncertainties include Aventra's differentiation within the peer cohort, customer traction visibility, and whether comparable valuations reflect genuine market pricing or capital-driven outliers.
